verdict.rationale: Godot's README says it offers one-click export to web-based platforms. Community reports confirm web export works, especially from Godot 3.5.2 with GDScript, but say C# projects in Godot 4 cannot be exported to the web. missing for 10: any evidence on payload size, explicit WebGL renderer documentation, any WebGPU roadmap or support, and hands-on corroboration of Godot 4 web export quality.
